_comment: MI325X distributed serving workload, TP8/PP2 on two eight-GPU nodes. Set the image, model, network environment and mounts before running. Threshold enforcement remains disabled until calibrated.

paths._comment: Host and container paths for model access, artifacts, and Hugging Face authentication.

container._comment: Container definition and static environment inherited by server, benchmark, and accuracy commands.
container.name: vllm_glm-51_fp8_distributed_mi325x
container._comment_socket_interfaces: NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME should be the Linux netdev associated with the selected RNICs; GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME and TP_SOCKET_IFNAME generally use the frontend or control-plane NIC.
container._comment_gid_index: Set NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX to the RoCE/IB GID index available on every selected HCA and node; inspect show_gids or ibv_devinfo -v inside the container and choose the matching fabric entry.

runtime.name: docker

args._comment_bnxt_mount: Broadcom Thor2 (bnxt_re). Bind-mounts host /usr/local/lib/libbnxt_re-rdmav34.so read-only onto the container libibverbs provider path. Delete this entry when the nodes have no Thor2 library; docker run fails if the host path is missing.
args._comment_ionic_mounts: AMD Pensando Ionic / AINIC. Bind-mounts libionic.so, libionic.so.1, the versioned libionic.so.1.* soname, libibverbs/libionic-rdmav34.so, and /etc/libibverbs.d/ionic.driver. Replace <changeme-libionic-soname> with the filename from readlink -f /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libionic.so.1. Delete these entries when the nodes have no Ionic stack; docker run fails if a host path is missing.

runtime._comment: Docker runtime and launch arguments applied on every participating node.

container._comment_image: Use a compatible ROCm vLLM image with support for this checkpoint and the selected backends; options and checkpoint support are version dependent.
container._comment_gpu_arch: These backend settings were exercised on MI325X (gfx942); revalidate them before using another GPU architecture.

server_params._comment: Harness fields plus snake-case vllm serve options.
server_params._comment_context: max_model_len covers the fixed ISL plus OSL with eight tokens of padding; update it when changing the sweep lengths.
server_params._comment_startup: The readiness polling budget allows slow checkpoint loading; it does not resolve tokenizer, backend or runtime compatibility failures.

benchmark_params._comment: Default vllm bench serve settings; per-cell values in sweeps override these defaults.

_comment_sweeps: Canonical run cells; entries override benchmark_params for that cell.
_comment_runs: Explicit ordered run cells to execute.
_comment_validation: Serving completion was exercised with vLLM 0.29.1.dev0+g98dff2a81.d20260911.rocm101 on gfx942. These settings do not establish model accuracy or calibrated performance thresholds.
